modules.title: 14 modules, build your own
modules.intro: Each plan includes a number of standard modules: {{start}} with START, {{business}} with BUSINESS, {{professional}} with PROFESSIONAL. The Sector Engine recommends a selection for your business. You can adjust it freely among the compatible modules. The technical Core does not count towards this number.
modules.extraModule: Additional standard module: {{amount}} excl. VAT per month per module, beyond the number included in your plan.

zeroReentry.title: Zero re-entry
zeroReentry.text: Information entered once is available in every module.

tracking.title: End-to-end tracking
tracking.text: You follow every order, from first contact to the accounting entry.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.text: Role-based access and multi-factor authentication for all users.

pricing.title: Four plans, the right capacity
pricing.introPrices: Public prices in FCFA, excluding VAT.
pricing.introLocation: No price is calculated per office, store or warehouse: the location of your teams is not a pricing criterion.
pricing.annual: Annual payment: 10 months billed for 12 months of service.
pricing.enterprise: Enterprise: dedicated, sovereign, hybrid or on-premise environment, SSO and specific SLA, sized on quote.
pricing.legal: Indicative prices excluding VAT and excluding set-up, migration and training services, which are quoted according to your project.

items.access: Role-based access and multi-factor authentication for all users; single sign-on depending on the offer.
items.encryption: Encryption of exchanges (TLS) and of data according to the architecture adopted.
items.isolation: Strict isolation between customers and automatic backups.
items.audit: Audit log of administration, billing and provisioning actions.

about.title: Your company is unique. So is your management platform.
about.p1: NELIAS BMP is a business management platform designed for African companies. We start from your business: you describe your activity, and NELIAS builds the management environment that fits it.
about.p2a: We believe a platform should be simple to buy, transparent to evolve and measurable to operate.
about.p2b: That is why our prices are public, in FCFA, and every line of a quote is explained.
about.p3: NELIAS BMP is powered by Debass Technologies, a telecoms and information-systems integrator based in Abidjan. We provide the product, the customer relationship and first-level support, with partners for development and hosting.
taglines: Your data, hosted close to you.

final.title: Tell us what your business does.
final.body: An advisor will reply and validate the configuration with you before any order.
